title: Need for Speed Unbound
summary: Stays on a black screen at start: the shader pre-build crashes after the few pipelines whose root signature D3DMetal cannot create. Six byte changes in the game's renderer DLL make it skip those and pre-build the rest, so the game neither crashes nor stutters as the first fix made it.

credits.name: macprotips
credits.note: Found the cause in the pre-build and wrote the six changes (NFSUnboundFix 1.1.0); the recipe carries their bytes, and the installer follows its checks: the sha256 before and after, a kept original, and undoing without it.

credits.name: Ariel O
credits.note: The first fix, in CodeWeavers' compatibility database: the shader pre-build turned off, which got the game running in CrossOver.

credits.name: u/ales_sandr
credits.note: Spread that first fix on Reddit.

excerpts.note: The six changes for Steam build 16690907, with the sha256 of the DLL before and after; any other build is left alone.
Each change written only where the expected bytes are, and undone the same way when the kept original is gone.

symptom: A black screen at start, and the game never reaches its menu.
cause: At start the game pre-builds the pipelines it saved from the last session. D3DMetal cannot create the root signature of a few of them, and the game crashes as it cleans up after those. Turning the pre-build off starts the game, but then every pipeline is built the first time it is drawn, which stutters.
fix: Engine.Render.Core2.PlatformPcDx12.dll is changed in six places: the cleanup skips an empty root-signature entry, and the graphics and compute pre-builds mark a pipeline whose root signature failed as failed, so the game drops it from the saved list and builds it when it is first drawn. Everything else is still pre-built. The original is kept beside the DLL, and only Steam build 16690907 is changed. Being tested: not played by MacGameFix yet.
